snippets.TEXT_ENDGAME: Congratulations! Now you are a PANDA MASTER!
snippets.TEXT_ENDROUND: Congratulations! You have reached the next initiation level.
snippets.TEXT_FAILED: False move! Do you want to see it again?
snippets.TEXT_INSTRUCTION: Welcome. I'm a Chinese Kung Fu master. If you want to learn the age-old secrets of the art of Kung Fu, follow my instructions. Kung Fu is all about concentration and endurance.
snippets.TEXT_INSTRUCTION2: Press the correct key on your keyboard.
snippets.TEXT_MASTERLOOK: Press the SPACE bar and remember the movements that you have seen.
snippets.TEXT_MASTERWELCOME: Panda-pupil. I'll show you the "$$form$$" form. Observe my movements closely and repeat them.
snippets.TEXT_NEXTPHASE: OK, it's time for a new form.
snippets.TEXT_STUDENTREADY: Press on the SPACE bar and repeat the movements of the master.
snippets.TEXT_TOOFAST: You are too impatient, young panda!
snippets.TEXT_TOOSLOW: You are too slow, young panda!
snippets.TEXT_WELCOME: Every panda can become a Kung Fu master. Meet the venerable Chinese master and learn the secrets of this martial art.
